heard: Tsutomu Yamaguchi was explaining the Hiroshima blast when the second bomb struck. Days earlier, the naval engineer was finishing a business trip in Hiroshima. At 8.15 a.m., the first atomic bomb detonated three kilometers away. Yamaguchi survived the heat and fled to the safety of Nagasaki. Bandaged and shaking, he reported for work on August 9th. His supervisor laughed, asking how one bomb could destroy a city. Suddenly the second blast erupted three kilometers from his office. He was forced to start his story over.
